text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp ends. All the 
Umamusume return to Tracen Academy to 
prepare for autumn.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see, so these are the projected entries 
for the "All Comers".

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Turbo-san and my names are naturally on 
it, of course, but...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—!? This Umamusume is... To think she'd 
show up here...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? And also... Teio-san's name isn't 
here?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Teio's name isn't on here? That's 
gotta be some kind of mistake!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
After all, Turbo even wrote a challenge 
letter after the Tanabata Sho!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
After the "Tanabata Sho"... It was quite 
some time ago, but did you ever get a 
reply?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Come to think of it...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo's gonna go talk to Teio for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was the challenge brushed aside, or did 
the schedules simply not align?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Or perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hup, hah, hoh... and done!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it doesn't hurt anymore. If I can 
move like this, I should somehow make it 
through the concert...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are! I've been looking for 
you, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Did you see my challenge? Turbo is going 
to run in the next 'All Comers'!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"A challenge...? Ah! That thing... stuck 
to the door...?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for not replying. A lot of... stuff 
came up, you know...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I see. But you still read it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Then it's a showdown! At the All Comers! 
Deal?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A match...? I'm sorry... I just... can't 
accept that.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm not... running anymore.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh... Why?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, if I win the All 
Comers, it's a promise for real this time.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I told you, I can't make a promise like 
that!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whyyy~!? No, no wayyy~! Race with Turbo! 
I'll win next time too! I'll run away with 
a massive lead!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm not running anymore. —Because I gave 
up.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So you should just give up on winning too.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What's that, that's so weird! Giving up is 
totally not like Teio! Not like Teio at 
all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...! What do you know about it?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Admitting that something is just no good 
is really, really painful, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"I don't care about that! The Teio Turbo 
knows would never give up!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It's because Teio was there that Turbo was 
able to make it this far!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'll win the next All Comers so Teio 
will wanna race me! I'll definitely lead 
wire-to-wire and win!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...There's no way I can lead all the way 
to the finish. So many strong Umamusume 
enter the All Comers every year..."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I heard this year is packed with heavy 
hitters. A blatant front-runner strategy 
like that would just..."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Turbo's still gonna win! I'm definitely 
gonna lead all the way to victory!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Teio, you big dummy!!!!! Waaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahhh, waaaahhh!! Teio, you big 
dummyyy...!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Ms. Turbo, what is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Uuuu... Traine~r, Ikuno~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo came back with a massive frown 
on her face.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So that's what happened... I had no idea. 
Don't tell me...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
To think Teio might be on the verge of 
retirement all because of a fracture...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. According to McQueen-san, there seems 
to be a slight chance I can regain my 
original abilities.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, the person in question has no 
intention to return to racing...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And it seems plans are underway for a 
farewell concert during the Holy Hoof 
Festival at the end of September.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uuuu~, so frustrating, frustrating, so 
frustrating, frustrating~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo will do it! Right in front of Teio, 
I'll definitely, definitely front-run all 
the way and win!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna show everyone what you can do if 
you just don't give up.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Turbo, I understand how you feel, but... 
it might be difficult to have Teio watch 
the race.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
This year's All Comers falls on the exact 
same day as the Holy Hoof Festival, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right... If that's the case, then Teio 
won't be able to watch Turbo's race, huh.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Eeeek, no way~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, do something~! Think of 
something! Please, think of something~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's gonna show Teio my running. If 
she's not here anymore... Turbo won't like 
it~. Uuuu~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though they begged me earnestly... it was 
quite a difficult request.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We can't let an Umamusume currently 
performing watch a race. Even if we 
could...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please, from me too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Teio's mind might be made up. But... if 
anyone can change it, I think it's Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be Turbo, who always blew away 
all our gloom with her wild, chaotic 
races!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I can't count how many times you've 
encouraged me...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Teio thinks Turbo can't win. If I can 
smash that assumption to pieces, then Teio 
might also...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, the only one who can do 
something about this hopeless situation is 
Twin Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it's Twin Turbo, who has overcome every 
single wall up until now through pure 
sheer will...
choice_data_list: Okay, lend me your ear for a sec.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The proposal was... a plan to hijack the 
stage screen during the farewell concert.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho, so basically, we hijack the display 
on stage and force it to play Turbo's race 
footage...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Showing Teio a dramatic victory, huh... 
She's gonna be super mad at me, but 
still...

text_block_list.name: Nature & Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: I can do this!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong, Ikuno?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: No... I think it's a great plan.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Trainer, in that case...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's bring back Teio's hope!
Yeah, let's bring back Teio's hope!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yay, yay, we did it!!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I can make things right with this. If I 
show her a victory, Teio will definitely 
want to run again, no doubt about it!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Twin Turbo was overjoyed. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I gaze out alone over the empty 
training grounds—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I came to have a talk. Regarding that 
"Holy Hoof Festival."
choice_data_list: If it's a discussion, earlier we...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, what I want to discuss isn't 
surface-level talk—it's realistic matters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the way she spoke... it seemed 
Ikuno Dictus had already noticed.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone else was rejoicing innocently. 
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"You understand, don't you? The main point 
of this plan isn't simply to make Teio-san 
watch the race."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That there's "another one."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Ikuno Dictus. Indeed, 
racing is not a fantasy. It is 
unequivocally a real competition...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The real plan to talk Tokai Teio out of it 
begins right here.
